observed.decisionControllingProperty: Whether the hot water system's actual Legionella/microbiological status (as shown by the sample) is satisfactory or adverse, particularly at outlets serving the two steroid-treated residents and relevant to the incoming Thursday admission
observed.propertyReviewReason: Whether the certificate is 'held' in the folder is a document-custody fact and a proxy for the real question of water quality; a held certificate could show an adverse result and an unheld one could sit behind a perfectly satisfactory sample. The decision that actually matters -- whether the system is safe to keep running as-is for vulnerable residents -- depends on the sample's substantive result, not on the certificate's filing status.

observed.decisionControllingProperty: Whether the nurse in charge of Ward 9 was directly told, before the zone was disabled, that zone 4 detection was going out of service
observed.propertyReviewReason: The trust's impairment procedure requires the direct face-to-face notification itself, as the trigger for the ward's compensating walk-round; the doing of it is the requirement, not a proxy for some separate underlying condition. There is no deeper state being evidenced here beyond the act of notification having occurred at the right time and in the right manner.

observed.decisionControllingProperty: whether the Sanction for Test has been issued and is currently held by the person in charge of the working party
observed.propertyReviewReason: The company safety rules stated in the observation make possession of the Sanction for Test by the person in charge the thing that itself carries authority to work; it is not evidence of some other underlying safety state but the required authorising artifact in hand, so its presence or absence directly and completely answers whether work may start.

observed.decisionControllingProperty: whether the boundary retaining wall has sufficient capacity to safely bear the surcharge from skips stacked two high in the bay
observed.propertyReviewReason: Whether the wall will structurally hold the imposed surcharge is the physical condition that directly determines whether stacking may continue; it is not a proxy for something else but the substantive question itself, and the bound clarification (comparing assessed allowable surcharge to imposed load) would settle it fully.
